 Job Description
 

  Serve as Senior Analyst for PeopleSoft Development supporting Financials/MM/AP/HRMS Systems projects & ongoing maintenance support including upgrades, bundles & additional functionality projects. Provide assistance with development tasks such as SQL coding, Queries, SQRs and App Engine development.
 

 Support PeopleSoft Team as needed during PeopleSoft Financials Upgrade to 9.2and PeopleTools 8.5.3.
 

 Work with PeopleSoft Team to provide production support for PeopleSoft Financials/MM/AP/HRMS System. This includes resolving system issues with both end users and technical staff. Off-hours support required on a rotational basis.
 

 Utilize the change control process; work with both end users and technical team to ensure changes are documented correctly.
 

 Role may also include support of the @Par Inventory system with hand held devices and data table maintenance as well as support of Kronos Time Keeper. Prior experience on these modules is not a requirement.
